original.target_description: Goal Frame × Decision Source interaction predicting whether a decision prioritized the goal in the worse position, logistic mixed-effects model with participant and trial random effects; 28,165 retained participant decisions paired with corresponding optimal-model decisions (56,330 modeled decisions). Supplied replication report p. 2 explicitly identifies this original target.

n.sample_role: modeled decision observations: 28,165 retained participant decisions plus corresponding optimal-model decisions, clustered within participants and trials; participant sample described as 20
n.exclusions: Excluded decisions with a goal already achieved/failed, equal goal scores, or equal expected values of the two actions. Technical difficulties prevented recording first trial for two participants; 51,081 recorded human decisions preceded analytic exclusions.
n.location: HTML Results, first paragraph (analytic observations); Method > Participants (participant sample)
n.quote: For each participant decision, we also analyzed the corresponding optimal decision. Thus, the total number of decisions analyzed was 56,330.

replication.target_description: Final analytic sample, all 20 participants including two online participants; goal frame × decision source interaction in mixed-effects logistic regression of choosing the goal in the better/worse position; participant and trial random effects. Target identified by the supplied replication report, p. 2 Claim Summary, because input has no separate effect locator.

n.sample_role: participants in the final analytic sample for the interaction model
n.exclusions: Main reported model retains two online participants whose sessions ended several trials short of 144; separate sensitivity analysis excludes them. Other exclusions not documented in report.

notes: No neutral description, study identifiers or effect locators were supplied. The supplied replication report explicitly identifies the original target as the goal frame × decision source interaction. Replication report is dated September 30, 2021, while supplied reference is dated 2025. Report supplies a statistical replication criterion and significant interaction results but no explicit narrative verdict of successful/failed replication; success value left null rather than inferred from significance. Original n records the explicitly printed number of model observations, not the generic participant total; there were 28,165 retained human decisions from a reported sample of 20 participants. No statistic was converted. Blindness exception: a general web search incidentally surfaced a prohibited third-party result snippet; that page was not opened, and every extracted value was independently checked against the acquired primary paper/report. No dataset or comparison files were consulted.
